title: Evidence signers
description: provenance/signers.json in an evidence/v1 export: the runner public keys that signed the export and, optionally, the log claim. The keys are claims by the exporter, not trust anchors: a verifier trusts only keys it was given out of band unless it is told to use these. Not expressible here and checked by the verifier: the file is the canonical JSON form; each key_id is the SHA-256 digest of the 32 raw bytes of its public_key; 1 to 64 signers; origin is 1 to 256 bytes of printable UTF-8 without leading or trailing space; the file is at most 1 MiB.

export_version.description: The export layout version; 1 in evidence/v1.

log.description: The log the exporter claims anchored the chain.

origin.description: Log origin line, such as numinance.test/log.

publicKey.description: An Ed25519 public key: 32 raw bytes as standard padded base64, 44 characters ending =.
